metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:protocol: Versioned finite diagnostic protocol; no runtime or validation improvement is presumed.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:replay: At most ten independently cloned cached batches; never advances a live loader.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:routing: Explicit host category identity checked against the model attribute when supplied.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampler_contract: Reserved MASK, real labels, B x L int64 arrays and all-MASK supervision; does not verify provenance or negative distribution.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_alignment: Mapped ordered off-diagonal mean cosine over up to 2048 real embeddings, seed 42. 0.5 means approximately zero cosine.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:mutation_suite: Ten dependent unchanged controls per fixture, then one isolated mutant and restoration control. Coverage excludes execution errors and missing evidence; Wilson interval is descriptive.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:serving_parity: Serialized export, authoritative vocabulary manifest and isolated ModelView forward state are not supplied to this adapter; numerical parity is unmeasured.
